title: CardCorpus static API manifest
description: Where everything is: the files, how a pointer finds what it names, how a picture id becomes a url, and how many of each thing there are.

description.description: What the dataset is, in a sentence.

version.description: The version of the shape these files follow (semver).

pictures.description: How a picture id becomes a url: fill `{id}` (and `{width}`, one of `widths`) into `original` or `sized` (docs/static-api.md, "Pictures").

original.description: The url of the picture as we have it, with `{id}`.

sized.description: The url of a copy at one of `widths`, with `{id}` and `{width}`.

widths.description: The widths a sized copy comes in, in pixels.

latest.description: A set's latest daily prices, with `{set}`.

sets.description: Up to 64 sets' latest prices at once, with `{sets}`: their ids joined by commas.

history.description: A card's price history, with `{set}` and `{card}`.

rates.description: The day's exchange rates, to show prices in another currency.

marketplaces.description: Where a card opens in a marketplace: fill a product id from marketplaces/ into `tcgplayer` or `cardmarket` (docs/static-api.md, "Marketplace ids").

catalogs.description: The catalogs, in the order lists use.

counts.description: How many of each thing the files hold, each named for its unit.

additionalProperties.description: How many there are of the thing the key names; always present, 0 included.

files.description: Every file, as a pattern whose `{…}` a pointer's ids fill, with its JSON Schema.

file.description: The file's path under /v1, with `{…}` for the ids that pick one.

pointers.description: How to find what a pointer points at, by its `$kind` (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers"): fill `file` from the pointer's ids and open it, then walk `path` in order, at each step picking from `list` the item whose `match` field equals the pointer's `by` field.

file.description: The file to open, with `{…}` filled from the pointer's ids.

path.description: The steps to walk, in order.

match.description: The field of each item to compare.

by.description: The pointer's field to compare it with.
